metadata.title: आदिवासियों के 56 संगठन सड़क पर क्यों बैठे हैं | Tribal Protest to demand roman script for language
metadata.description: In Agartala today, a significant development unfolded as 56 tribal organisations initiated a dharna, demanding a momentous change for the tribal language of Tripura. The protesters fervently called for the adoption of the Roman script for Kokborok, the indigenous language of the state. Currently written in the Bangla script, this demand has long been a contentious and highly debated political issue. Our ground report brings you the latest updates on this influential movement, providing a comprehensive understanding of the significance and implications of this demand. Stay tuned for more details on our YouTube channel.
